title: Brazilian Wrap
description: A flavorful and spicy wrap filled with chorizo, onions, and bell peppers, inspired by Brazilian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cook the sliced chorizo sausage for 3-4 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, grill the sliced bell peppers and onions for 3-4 minutes per side, until tender.
Warm the Brazilian wraps according to package instructions.
Assemble the wraps by placing cooked chorizo, bell peppers, and onions onto the warmed wraps.
Drizzle with Quick Fix Wrap Sauce (or Salsa) to taste.
